items.q: How is the SEO score calculated?
items.a: It checks on-page basics such as title, meta description, headings, content length, images and links, then gives a score out of 100 with a fix list.
Start with the red items on the list, especially a missing or duplicate title, a missing H1 and images without alt text.

items.q: Is the on-page SEO checker free?
items.a: Yes. The on-page SEO checker is free to use as often as you like, with no sign-up or login.
No. The HTML you paste is checked inside your browser and nothing is uploaded.

items.q: Can you audit my whole website?
items.a: Yes. A full audit is where our SEO team starts, covering technical, on-page and content issues.
